question: How many movies are in the Top 250?
gold_sql: select count(*) from movies where rank is not null

question: Which movie is ranked number one in the Top 250?
gold_sql: select title from movies where rank = 1

question: Which director has the most films in the Top 250?
gold_sql: select p.name from credits c join people p using (person_id) join movies m using (tmdb_id) where m.rank is not null and c.job = 'Director' group by p.name order by count(distinct c.tmdb_id) desc limit 1

question: What is the IMDb rating of The Dark Knight?
gold_sql: select imdb_rating from movies where title = 'The Dark Knight' and year = 2008

question: Which Top 250 movie has the most IMDb votes?
gold_sql: select title from movies where rank is not null order by imdb_votes desc limit 1

question: How many Top 250 movies were released in the 1990s?
gold_sql: select count(*) from movies where rank is not null and year between 1990 and 1999

question: What is the oldest movie in the Top 250?
gold_sql: select title from movies where rank is not null order by year, release_date limit 1

question: Which Top 250 movie earned the highest worldwide revenue?
gold_sql: select title from movies where rank is not null and revenue_usd is not null order by revenue_usd desc limit 1

question: List the Top 250 movies directed by Christopher Nolan.
gold_sql: select m.title from credits c join people p using (person_id) join movies m using (tmdb_id) where m.rank is not null and c.job = 'Director' and p.name = 'Christopher Nolan'

question: Which genre appears most often in the Top 250?
